verdict.rationale: Lago has a dedicated API versioning page establishing a v1 API and a compatibility contract: clients should tolerate additive changes such as new fields, enum values, endpoints and webhook event types (lago-docs-8). Endpoints are served under /api/v1 (lago-docs-17), and a published OpenAPI schema backs this (lago-probe-3). However, the evidence never shows an explicit deprecation policy covering notice periods, sunset timelines or breaking-change handling. Missing for 10: documented deprecation and sunset policy with timelines, breaking-change and version-migration process, independent corroboration.
